def snap(f):
    out={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('R','b','N') and n['pixels']==16:
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            if min(rs)<50: out[n['color']]=(min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
    g=[list(r) for r in f.ascii.splitlines()]
    tip=None
    for r in range(12,45):
        for c in range(49,16,-1):
            if g[r][c] in 'wg': tip=(r,c); break
        if tip: break
    return out, tip
